title: Identification whose driver_guid isn't a UUID
description: Design O8.1, second half. A Type 7 arrives through the webhook with a driver_guid that isn't a UUID. HARDBRAKE at 30, identification at 70, trip end at 150. Must prove: be-crud's contact lookup answers 422, the identification consumer logs the error and rejects the message to its error queue, and no row is written. Must NOT change: the asset assignee, the trip assignee, or the violation's attribution.
